description: Immeuble Eligibilité GPS - T1 2026 is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP, Grand Paris Sud. Ce jeu de données présente le croisement Immeuble x Techno tel que publié par l’Arcep qui met à disposition une version bêta d'un jeu de données pour partager l’avancée de ses travaux et lancer une phase de co-construction avec les acteurs pour préparer la finalisation de la première version complète de l’outil Ma connexion Internet. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Télecommunications. Its keywords are arcep, immeuble, technologie numérique, éligibilité. The portal shows 70,981 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
